fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the article page's bare NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, tribuneindia.com/recent-sitemap.xml) carry title/link/lastmod fields since this site exposes no RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (not_found, http_<code>, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, raw passthrough from JSON-LD. Carries a " - The Tribune" SEO title-tail suffix as authored by the CMS.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article content, from the JSON-LD NewsArticle node (present on every sampled article).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline object as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough -- a single Person dict on this site, e.g. {"@type": "Person", "name": "PTI", "url": "..."}).

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL, duplicated as a flat string.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Array of topic/keyword tags from JSON-LD. On some articles this is a single-item array duplicating the headline instead of real tags -- a CMS quirk, passed through as-is.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag. Observed true on every sampled article -- this site does not appear to gate news content behind a paywall.

sameAs.title: Same as
sameAs.description: The Tribune's own social media profile links (Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp/X/YouTube) -- not article-specific, present on every article's JSON-LD.

speakable.title: Speakable specification
speakable.description: Schema.org SpeakableSpecification CSS-selector hint for voice assistants.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item, from the sitemap's image:title.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL (latest-mode), from the sitemap item's loc.

lastmod.title: Last modified
lastmod.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (latest-mode), from the sitemap item's lastmod.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
